ctx.x: And his brother was a trumpet player, Bat. Bat Brown. We used to call him Bat Brown. And we used to go to rehearsal way uptown. And he used to come down here all the time. He was, this fella was well known. He had plenty of little jobs. He played plenty of jobs with him. How did he play? What type of trombone was his name? He was a good trombone player. Like anybody else that you can think of playing today that we might- Oh, he played all the style of his gym down there.
Something like Jim Robinson. Yeah, he played all that style. He was a good man. A pretty loud tone and all. Yeah, yeah. Very loud. Very loud. You know when he died or how long- No, I didn't know.
When I heard of it, you know, he had been dead.
